scope: Independent local read-only source and tracked-byte review. No Rust execution, ONNX inference, fixture regeneration, remote call, product edit, tolerance change, or new runtime qualification.

source_binding.comparison: Each listed local file was compared byte-for-byte with git show <native_freeze_commit>:<path>.

failure_context.provenance: Parent agent reported full-workspace-rust-1.99.0-r4 exit 101 at the two existing pipecat-turns integration cases. This receipt has not independently consumed that run's raw log.
failure_context.cannot_claim: Later is_complete, paired context, one LLM call, buffer reset and worker End/join assertions lie after the failing assertion.

tracked_input.representation_note: The reference is exactly the f64 expansion of an f32 value. Reading the same f32 metric as f64 does not itself explain a 1e-5 discrepancy.

statically_observed_path: SyntheticStt forwards the original InputAudio frame, then emits a final fixed transcription; it does not transform PCM.
Detailed VAD start sets vad_start_secs=0.2 and vad_speaking=true. The default buffer pre_speech_ms=500 yields a 0.7-second chunk-selection preroll, not synthetic audio.
The single speech chunk is shorter than the default 128000-sample maximum and is retained in full. analysis_samples selects whole chunks; the only chunk remains included.
Detailed VAD stop sets vad_speaking=false and requests analysis. Its stop_secs=0.2 is not converted to silence samples in this path.
The analyzer worker passes its snapshot to the same SmartTurnModel cancellable entry point. It does not resample or independently pad the PCM.
SmartTurnModel endpoint_window retains the final 128000 samples and front-pads this short sample with 47001 zeros, dividing PCM16 values by 32768 as float32.
WhisperFeatureExtractor then computes the same normalized 80x800 log-mel tensor used by the direct golden path.
Model session construction requests sequential execution, one inter-op and one intra-op thread, full graph optimization. Per-run cancellation uses fresh RunOptions.
The aggregator publishes the analyzer's f32 probability in smart_turn metadata; it does not recompute the probability.

oracle_provenance_limits.generator_record: smart_turn_oracle.json records NumPy 2.3.5, onnxruntime 1.21.0, source/model/WAV SHA256 and front-pad/final-128000 semantics.
oracle_provenance_limits.note: The oracle speech_sha256 dbfccc2e39b708ff8cad6ec3139e87e42004be04b6328ad42304ff215e80d8ad identifies the original WAV, not the tracked PCM blob. This review verifies current tracked model/PCM/features/reference bytes against the native freeze; it does not claim fresh Python reproduction or loss/absence of those files on every host.
oracle_provenance_limits.historical_scope: README/SMART_TURN.md describe contracts and fixture provenance. Accessible earlier full-workspace logs did not establish execution of the actual Smart Turn suites; earlier retained DRAFT_QUALIFICATION.md explicitly marked smart_turn_onnx_pipeline NOT_RUN. Prior documentation is not a fresh passing result.

interpretation_branches.conclusion_limit: Investigate native preprocessing vs pinned features. Do not first blame the aggregator or change model/reference.

interpretation_branches.observation: Features pass and direct model probability golden fails
interpretation_branches.conclusion_limit: Failure exists below the aggregator; compare actual model/runtime identity and numeric inference with pinned oracle. This alone does not establish CPU or resource causation.

interpretation_branches.observation: Direct model passes but independent analyzer fails
interpretation_branches.conclusion_limit: Focus on analyzer snapshot, worker and cancellation path; obtain exact input and actual probability.

interpretation_branches.observation: Direct model and independent analyzer pass but pipeline still fails
interpretation_branches.conclusion_limit: Obtain pipeline's actual probability/expected/delta before attributing the discrepancy; a transparent real-model input-boundary observation may then be justified.

minimum_candidate_if_new_observation_is_.status: Proposed only; not applied. Parent requested waiting for existing no-fail-fast results first.
minimum_candidate_if_new_observation_is_.change: Add actual probability, unchanged expected, absolute delta and existing smart_turn metric metadata to the original pipeline assertion's failure message.
minimum_candidate_if_new_observation_is_.preserved: Original test cases, real model, fixture/reference bytes, <1e-5 predicate, 20s receive timeout, 10s STT timeout, subsequent assertions and owner cleanup.
minimum_candidate_if_new_observation_is_.excluded_now: No predictor wrapper, new model case, re-run, regenerated oracle, altered padding or widened tolerance.
